title: Oven Roasted Slovakian Blackeye Pea Skewers
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring blackeye peas, roasted to perfection in the oven with a crispy exterior and a tender interior, wrapped in ti leaves for added flavor and moisture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the dried blackeye peas and soak them in water for at least 8 hours.
Drain and rinse the soaked blackeye peas, then mix them with olive oil, garlic, onion, paprika, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Thread the blackeye pea mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each pea.
Wrap each skewer in a ti leaf, securing it with a toothpick if needed.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional paprika if desired.
Repeat the process until all the blackeye pea mixture is used up.
